## Primary Software Engineering Projects

1. OPERON
   - Purpose: Operations platform exploring multi-agent business workflows across Support, Finance, and HR with human-in-the-loop checkpoints for critical decisions.
   - Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, Multi-Agent AI Architecture, REST API.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/Operon
   - Live Demo: https://operonpro.vercel.app

2. MAUSAM
   - Purpose: Weather intelligence and atmospheric analytics platform built for Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) by Team ALGNITE, unifying Doppler radar nowcasting, SACHET/NDMA alerts, NAQI air quality, INCOIS marine state, and Ask MAUSAM AI.
   - Stack: TypeScript, React, Python, Tailwind CSS, Weather APIs, C, PLpgSQL.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/mausam_sih-26 (earlier SIH snapshot: https://github.com/codesbysayam/mausam_sample)
   - Live Demo: https://mausamgovt.vercel.app

3. SightForge
   - Purpose: Dual-service real-time computer vision platform pairing a Next.js 15 / React 19 16:9 HTML5 Canvas client with FastAPI YOLOv8 person detection (COCO Class ID 0), 17-keypoint pose estimation, IoU 0.45 NMS, ByteTrack tracking, and PostgreSQL persistence (self-hosted local runtime).
   - Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, YOLOv8, ByteTrack, PostgreSQL.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/SightForge

4. Memory in Motion
   - Purpose: Interactive mechanistic interpretability lab built for DataForge 2026 (IIT Kharagpur) contrasting O(1) fixed-size recurrent state and Hebbian fast weights (including Dragon Hatchling / BDH) against O(T) KV caches.
   - Stack: TypeScript, React, KaTeX, D3.js, Python, Tailwind CSS.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/Memory-in-Motion
   - Live Demo: https://memoryinmotion.vercel.app

5. AXIOM
   - Purpose: Autonomous operations control plane built in 36 hours for WCC Launchpad 30 featuring deterministic policy rules, approval gates, failure recovery, dry-run sandboxes, and tamper-evident audit chains.
   - Stack: TypeScript, React, Control Plane Policy Engine, Audit Chain.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/AXIOM
   - Live Demo: https://axiomwcc.vercel.app

6. INKLOOM
   - Purpose: Public fork workspace (default branch: master, isFork: true) exploring constructed AI logo design pipelines—turning brand constraints into typography/symbol marks and composition lockups (early access open; specialized logo models under construction).
   - Stack: TypeScript, React, PLpgSQL, Docker, CSS.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/inkloom
   - Early Access: https://inkloom.art

7. Campus Connect
   - Purpose: Full-stack Next.js and TypeScript campus event management platform pairing student discovery and registration with an organizer dashboard and Vitest suite (uses README-documented seeded in-memory storage that resets on restart).
   - Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, React, Vitest, Tailwind CSS.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/CAMPUSCONNECT_1273
   - Live Demo: https://campusconnect1273.vercel.app/

8. SayamSolves
   - Purpose: Open-source C++ Data Structures & Algorithms repository synced via LeetHub V2, tracking 3 solution files in stats.json (LC 0005, 0033, 0115) alongside a verified 4-problem LeetCode profile baseline.
   - Stack: C++, Data Structures, Algorithms, LeetHub V2, LeetCode.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/sayam-solves

9. Interactive Developer Portfolio (Site Meta Repository)
   - Purpose: Full-stack developer portfolio and engineering showcase with pre-rendered 11-repo GitHub telemetry, dark/light editorial design system, and verified credentials archive.
   - Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Express, Vite, Motion.
   - Repository: https://github.com/codesbysayam/Sayam-Mukherjee-Portfolio
   - Live Site: https://sayammukherjee.in

## Website Architecture & Telemetry Principles

- Pre-Rendered Telemetry: Repository stats and commit metrics are fetched via scheduled GitHub Actions into static JSON (`public/data/github.json`), preventing client-side API rate limits.
- Privacy First: Zero tracking cookies; strictly optional cookieless telemetry; anonymized UTM attribution with user consent.
- Liquid Glass Design: Restrained Apple/iOS-inspired translucent surfaces, keyboard navigation, and responsive typography.
